description.value: Pescadores Bistro is a walk-in-only brunch and lunch restaurant in Port Alberni, perched across from the Alberni Inlet and Marina with a landscaped outdoor patio where wildlife sightings are common. The menu ranges from eggs benedict and omelettes to fish tacos and fresh-ground beef burgers, with vegan and gluten-free options throughout. It sits on the main highway corridor to Tofino, positioning it as a natural midpoint fuel stop for cyclists heading to the Pacific coast.
